items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: The transcript only shows the interviewer introducing himself as Monk Rowe. There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between Oliver Nelson Jr. and Monk Rowe beyond the interviewer-interviewee dynamic.

ctx.x: Oliver was interviewed via Zoom on September 10, 2020 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Oliver Nelson Jr. with me on a nice afternoon for talking music. And congratulations on your career so far.
